resources.string: Open KaroRide or choose an action

KaroRide uses the Insta360 Camera SDK for Bluetooth control. Camera selection and wake-up identifier are stored only on this Karoo. The app requests no internet access.

SDK terms and privacy information: hellmold.de/karoride/datenschutz.html and insta360.com/support/supportcourse?post_id=20734.

Accepting allows SDK initialisation for camera control. It does not start a recording.

Wait for the current action and stop or pause recording before switching.
It may still be recording. Switching only disconnects it; no stop command is sent.

Ace Pro: enable Bluetooth Wakeup in Settings → General. GO 3S: confirm first connection on the Action Pod or using the shutter. Wake up attempts an authorised connection; only a camera reply confirms the state.
GO 3S uses an authorised Bluetooth connection. It does not need an Ace Pro wake-up identifier. Wake-up outside the Action Pod still needs a hardware test.
Identifier saved locally. Enable Bluetooth Wakeup on the camera, power it off, then test Wake up.
